description: A date slicer that knows your calendar. Pick dates the fast way - one click on a preset, two clicks in the calendar, a drag across the timeline or typed dates in your own format - and always see in plain words what is selected: "Month to date, Sep 1 - 27, 2026, 27 days, 19 working days". Presets that keep rolling after you publish. Save the report on Month to date and it is still month to date next week - no one has to log in and move the slicer. Your viewers can always pick something else; Reset brings the default back. Free features - no licence needed: Calendar (1-3 months), timeline with year / quarter / month / week / day, compact bar with previous / next stepping, presets list; Auto picks the layout that fits the space and falls back to the presets list or a one-line compact bar on small tiles Relative date presets: today, this / last / next week, month, quarter, half-year and year, week / month / quarter / year to date, last 7 / 30 / 90 / 365 days, rolling and full 12 months - and viewers can pick their own "last or next N days, weeks, months, quarters or years" Presets that end on the latest date with data instead of today - set when the report opens and moved forward only when later data appears, never pulled back by filtering in other visuals Fiscal years from any month; weeks starting Monday, Sunday or Saturday; ISO week numbers Public holidays for 21 countries…
